info.name: Notes CalDAV
info.summary: CalDAV VJOURNAL integration for Nextcloud Notes
info.description:
Notes CalDAV connects the Nextcloud Notes app to CalDAV clients.
It exposes Nextcloud Notes as VJOURNAL objects without DTSTART, allowing compatible clients such as DAVx5 and jtx Board to synchronize notes with Nextcloud.
Nextcloud Notes remains the canonical storage.
Features:
- VJOURNAL synchronization through CalDAV - DAVx5 and jtx Board support - Create Notes from CalDAV clients - Update existing Notes - Delete Notes - Preserve Notes categories as CATEGORIES - Preserve favorite state - Stable note IDs mapped to CalDAV resources
Attachments are not yet synchronized.
